info: MASTER REFERENCE EXPANDED - File 02 - Numbers & Time

words.pinyin: Yǒu liǎng gè rén zài ma ？
Wǒ men yǒu wǔ fēn zhōng ma ？
Nǐ néng shù dào shí ma ？

words.en: Do we only have fifteen left?
words.zh: 我们只剩下十五个了吗？
words.pinyin: Wǒ men zhī shèng xià shí wǔ gè le ma ？
Shì èr shí měi yuán ma ？
Shì bǎi fēn zhī wǔ shí ma ？

words.en: Is it on the third floor?

words.pinyin: Zhè shì zuì hòu yí gè ma ？
Nǐ de diàn huà hào mǎ shì duō shǎo ？
Nà shì hěn dà yì bǐ shù mù ma ？

words.en: Is the population nearly three million?
words.pinyin: Rén kǒu jiē jìn sān bǎi wàn ma ？

words.en: We negotiated a twenty percent discount overall.
words.zh: 我们谈成了总共百分之二十的折扣。
words.pinyin: Wǒmen tánchéng le zǒnggòng bǎifēn zhī èrshí de zhékòu

words.en: Their budget is just under half a million.
words.zh: 他们的预算不到五十万。
words.pinyin: Tāmen de yùsuàn bú dào wǔshí wàn

words.en: You'll find the office on the twenty-first floor.
Can you set a reminder for 4 PM?
words.zh: 你能设个下午4点的提醒吗？
words.pinyin: Nǐ néng shè gè xià wǔ 4 diǎn de tí xǐng ma ？
Wǒ men zhè zhōu mò néng jiàn miàn ma ？

words.en: Can we start around quarter past nine?
words.zh: 我们可以在九点一刻左右开始吗？
words.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ zài jiǔ diǎn yī kè zuǒyòu kāishǐ ma?

words.en: Does the workshop run for forty minutes?
words.zh: 研讨会进行四十分钟吗？
words.pinyin: Yán tǎo huì jìn xíng sì shí fēn zhōng ma ？

words.en: Could we push it back to early evening?
words.zh: 我们可以把它推迟到傍晚吗？
words.pinyin: Wǒ men kě yǐ bǎ tā tuī chí dào bàng wǎn ma ？

words.en: Can I join after my 2 PM appointment ends?
words.zh: 我可以在下午2点的约会结束后加入吗？
words.pinyin: Wǒ kě yǐ zài xià wǔ 2 diǎn de yuē huì jié shù hòu jiā rù ma ？
Nǐ míng tiān zuò shén me ？
Wǒ zuó tiān jiàn dào tā le 。
Wǒ xià zhōu gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà 。
Nǐ jīn tiān guò dé zěn me yàng ？
Wǒ men zhè ge yuè yào zǒu 。

words.en: Did you go there last year?
words.pinyin: Nǐ qù nián qù guò nà ér ma ？

words.en: What are you doing on Saturday?
words.pinyin: Nǐ zhōu liù zuò shén me ？

words.zh: 周五是我最喜欢的一天。
words.pinyin: Zhōu wǔ shì wǒ zuì xǐ huan de yì tiān 。
Nǐ zhōu rì yǒu kōng ma ？
Wǒ de shēng rì zài sān yuè 。
Xià tiān shén me shí hòu kāi shǐ ？
Wǒ men shì yī yuè fèn rèn shi de 。
Nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ gè jì jié ？
Shí èr yuè zǒng shì hěn máng 。
Nǐ xǐ huan qiū tiān ma ？
